thread:
Maya: Kicking off canary for release v2.14.1 to prod-us-west now. Deploybot: Canary rollout initiated (cny-8912) — 20% traffic. Maya: TL;DR: watch error-rate, KV cache misses, and embeddings latency. Priya: Copy, I'll own monitoring and notes. Alex: p50 looks fine so far — 28ms. p95 190ms, slight tail. Dan: Starting synthetic traffic against embeddings route. If errors >0.5% for 5m, request immediate pin + backout. Jordan: Acknowledged, I'll be on-call for rollback. Maya: Ops-runbook link in case of backout: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/backout-v2-14-1 — follow 'fast-unwind' section. ops-runbook-bot: Runbook fetched: backout-v2-14-1, fast-unwind checklist v1.2. Alex: Small spike on embedding inference 02:18, errors 0.3% -> watching. Priya: Alert rule set: embeddings-error-rate > 0.5% for 5m triggers page. Dan: I'm seeing KV cache miss rate climb to 12% on host eg-3. Adding that to watchlist. Maya: If KV miss >15% and latency p95 > 250ms for 3m, fallback to model v2.13.9 and pin traffic. Jordan: Can we confirm steps to pin traffic? Maya: Steps: 1) run deploybot pin cny-8912 --target v2.13.9 2) run deploybot abort cny-8912 3) notify release@ and update incident channel. Dan: I'll be primed to run those commands. Alex: Quick logging snippet if needed:
```
# pin to previous model
deploybot pin --rollout-id cny-8912 --version v2.13.9
# abort canary
deploybot abort --rollout-id cny-8912 --reason "canary-unwind"
```
Priya: Prep release notes update if we back out: add note about embeddings regression and KV cache tuning. Maya: Also enable canary shield: route 100% of traffic to dedicated pool after pin, so cost spike but isolates impact. Jordan: If we do a backout, I'll run postmortem prefill checklist. ops-runbook-bot: Fast-unwind checklist (summary): stop canary -> pin previous image -> clear KV warmers -> run sanity smoke -> scale dedicated pool -> notify downstream teams. Maya: Agreed. Dan: If we hit >0.5% errors and persistent for 5m, I will run pin + abort. Alex: Monitoring runbook link: https://grafana.internal/d/rr-monitoring/canary-v2-14-1 (watch p95, errors, cache-miss). Priya: Reactions: :thumbsup: prepping playbook snippets in the release doc. Maya: Ok team, hold pattern. I'll call the backout if criteria hit. deploybot: Canary at 40% traffic — no abort. Alex: Noting small tail, no action yet. Dan: 02:22 — errors 0.6% sustained for 6m on embeddings-route. Dan: Executing pin now. Maya: Running abort now. deploybot: Pin command accepted — routing pinned to v2.13.9. deploybot: Canary aborted (cny-8912) — reason: embeddings error threshold breach. ops-runbook-bot: Post-abort checklist triggered: start cleanup, run cache-warmers, annotate runbook with timeline. Jordan: Notifying release@ and incident channel. Priya: Updating release notes and marking rollback in notes. Alex: Aftermath metrics: p95 back to 120ms, errors back to baseline. Maya: Good work. We'll do a quick sync later for root cause and kv-tuning plan. Dan: Filing follow-up ticket: INF-4521 with logs and heap snapshots. Maya: Thanks everyone. Thread closed after backout.
